text: i just saw a girl on tiktok and she said i always feel sad on dating apps because i look at all the men that like me or the men putting themselves out there and i'm declining them and they're trying their best you know they're just trying to find love too and they're just trying to find someone and she's saying no to them and she just feels sad for them because there's so many of them out there and i had an epiphany and i was like wow to ask you know we have more empathy and our little baby finger than most men in the entire world because a man would never even have a thought or even occur to think that way about a woman they find unattractive look i think both men and women have empathy to a decent degree but when it comes to dating women should be the last ones to talk about empathy because women have no idea what dating feels like for an average guy how many rejections ghostings and ignorings a man goes through just to get a date the amount of effort guys put in messaging first planning the date making sure everything runs smoothly and a lot of the time it goes nowhere if that doesn't require patience and emotional control i don't know what does and honestly in dating men do show empathy all the time when we plan something we try to make sure the time works for her the place is comfortable the vibe feels right we normally take into consideration her schedule her mood her boundaries most men actually think about how woman will feel before during and after the date and even when things don't click many guys still try to end it politely with a hey it's not you it's me or you are great but i just don't feel the connection that's empathy too so yeah both genders can have empathy but in dating men probably show way more of it than most women ever realize
